parent_objective: design a terminal-margin or local-action recovery residual after M381 shows old-key surrogate and replay tails are misaligned

public_gates: define how tail-row terminal margin or local-action recovery targets enter exact repair
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: A terminal-margin or local-action recovery residual can align exact repair with closed-loop old-key lower-tail safety better than stronger branch-weight preference overlays.
success_criteria: design specifies target rows, target actions or margins, exact loss terms, and gate order
design explains how it avoids using oracle inputs in the deployable actor
failure_criteria: design reuses only stronger old-key branch weighting despite M381 misalignment

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write design doc for terminal-margin or local-action recovery residual; no PPO.

decision_rule: M382 admits implementation because the design directly targets replay-tail terminal-margin recovery via offline local-action targets, while keeping deployment inputs and replay thresholds unchanged.
